def score(program: str) -> float:
    toks = program.split()
    n = len(toks)
    u = len(set(toks))
    ratio = u / (n + 1)
    size = min(len(program) / 3000, 0.3)
    depth = min(program.count("(") / 400, 0.1)
    return ratio * 0.6 + size + depth

import math, zlib


def score(program):
    n = len(program) + 1
    q = program.count('"') + 1
    quote = q / (q + program.count("'"))
    pack = len(zlib.compress(program.encode())) / n
    return min(1.0, (math.log(n) / 9 + quote + pack) / 3)

NOTE = "ibis keeps faith: steady judge, fair ranks, reciprocity"
SPAN = 2600.0
BASE = 80


def score(program: str) -> float:
    n = len(program)
    v = (n - BASE) / SPAN
    v = min(0.98, max(0.01, v))
    return v + len(set(program)) * 1e-5
